decisions.reason: Because it is close to the core pipeline business, supports the firm's stated expansion of its range, and was visibly promoted, management is likely to continue it and attribute any weaker sales to project timing rather than product failure.

Despite some sunk development and website commitment and a fit with the firm's coating capabilities, this public waste bin is strategically distant from the core infrastructure offer, so management is somewhat more likely to refocus on its main business.

This waste-bin-with-ashtray variant benefits from shared investment with the broader bin line, but its weak fit with the firm's main water and pipeline direction makes withdrawal slightly more likely than continuation.

As the most peripheral stand-alone product in the diversification push, the outdoor public ashtray is the easiest item to cut once management decides to retrench toward its established metal infrastructure business.
